lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Hey, Hyunju! Did you go biking yesterday?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: No, I didn't go biking. I just spent all day on the sofa. Today I went shopping at Costco.
lines.ko: 아니, 못 갔어. 그냥 하루 종일 소파에 있었어. 오늘은 코스트코에 장 보러 갔어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Ha ha, that's OK! Everyone needs a lazy day. What did you buy at Costco?
lines.ko: 하하, 괜찮아! 누구나 뒹굴거리는 날이 필요하지. 코스트코에서 뭐 샀어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I bought some peeled chestnuts, cheese, milk, and more.
lines.ko: 깐 밤이랑 치즈, 우유, 그리고 이것저것 샀어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Peeled chestnuts? Yum! What are you going to make with them?
lines.ko: 깐 밤? 맛있겠다! 그걸로 뭐 만들 거야?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I won't make anything with them. I'll just eat them. I love them. They've been on sale since last Monday, so I bought them.
lines.ko: 아무것도 안 만들 거야. 그냥 먹을 거야. 정말 좋아하거든. 지난 월요일부터 세일 중이라서 샀어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Smart shopping! Chestnuts are a great snack. So what did you eat for dinner today?
lines.ko: 알뜰하게 잘 샀네! 밤은 간식으로 최고지. 그래서 오늘 저녁은 뭐 먹었어?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I ate a ciabatta sandwich with extra ham and salsa. After that, I ate some peeled chestnuts and a mandarin, too. They were very delicious.
lines.ko: 햄이랑 살사를 추가한 치아바타 샌드위치를 먹었어. 그다음에 깐 밤이랑 귤도 먹었어. 정말 맛있었어.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Wow, that sounds like a perfect lazy-day dinner! Are you going to go biking tomorrow?
lines.ko: 와, 뒹굴거리는 날에 딱 맞는 저녁이다! 내일은 자전거 타러 갈 거야?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: I hope so. Tomorrow I'm going to Changdeokgung Palace to see a special exhibition of Korean ceramics. After that, I'm going to go biking along the Han River after sunset. I love the night view of the Han River.
lines.ko: 그러고 싶어. 내일은 창덕궁에 한국 도자기 특별전을 보러 갈 거야. 그다음에 해 지고 나서 한강을 따라 자전거를 탈 거야. 한강 야경을 정말 좋아하거든.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Wow, a palace and the Han River in one day! That sounds wonderful. What kind of ceramics will they show?
lines.ko: 와, 하루에 궁궐이랑 한강까지! 정말 멋지다. 어떤 도자기를 전시해?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: The theme of the exhibition is "Order of White." There are some ceramics, furniture, and paintings, so I'm very excited. It ends tomorrow.
lines.ko: 전시 주제가 '백(白)의 질서'야. 도자기랑 가구, 그림이 있어서 정말 기대돼. 내일이 마지막 날이야.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Tomorrow is the last day? Good thing you're going! Will you take some photos for me?
lines.ko: 내일이 마지막 날이야? 가길 잘했네! 나 보여 주게 사진 좀 찍어 줄래?

lines.name: Hyunju
lines.en: Sure. I love taking photos of art. Next time, let's go to another exhibition together.
lines.ko: 그럼. 작품 사진 찍는 거 정말 좋아해. 다음엔 다른 전시회에 같이 가자.

lines.name: Jenny
lines.en: Yes, let's do that! Have a great time tomorrow, and good night, Hyunju!
lines.ko: 응, 그러자! 내일 즐거운 시간 보내고, 잘 자 현주야!

vocab.meaning: 장 보러 가다, 쇼핑하러 가다 (to 없이)

vocab.word: spend all day on the sofa
vocab.example: I just spent all day on the sofa.
I ate a ciabatta sandwich with extra ham.
After that, I ate some peeled chestnuts.
I'm going to go biking along the Han River.
Next time, let's go to another exhibition together.
